messages:
maria: ok re: tonight's swing handoff — I'm going to be primary until 02:00 UTC but there's a weird gap 00:30-01:15 where no APAC overlap. can someone confirm secondary coverage?
kevin: I can take secondary from 23:45-01:30 UTC, but i'll need grafana and pagerduty access checked briefly before my shift. :handshake:
tara: noted. kevin, do you have the grafana org role? last time you only had viewer. you need at least Editor on dashboards/redwood-inference.
sam: also confirm PD escalation permissions — the rotation role should be "oncall:escalate" otherwise you can't acknowledge for P1s.
maria: good call. kevin, try this quick checklist: 1) PagerDuty sign-in, 2) Grafana dashboard open, 3) assume AWS oncall role. I pasted runbooks below.
kevin: running through now. signing into PD — ok i'm in, i can see the rota but the "Responders" tab shows limited actions. getting a permission denied when trying to escalate.
maria: which PD account? org-level or team-level?
kevin: team-level (infra-oncall). i think my user is in infra-read, not infra-oncall.
tara: that explains it — infra-oncall group controls escalation. @sam can you add kevin to infra-oncall or grant escalation rights?
sam: i can add him but need a brief JIT approval from sec due to recent permission cleanup. i'll ping security now.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT BOT: Reminder — if you cannot escalate, use the fallback policy: contact the primary via @-mention and call the P1 phone line. See https://redwood.internal/pd/fallback-policy
maria: meanwhile kevin, can you access Grafana?
kevin: grafana -> dashboards -> /redwood/production/latency loads but when opening the ops alert panel it says "insufficient permissions". i can view panels but not silence alerts.
tara: you need grafana team role "Alert Manager" for silencing. smol config change in org settings. i can uplift you for tonight if sec approves.
maria: AWS access — kevin, try assuming the oncall role:

```
# assume oncall role
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/RedwoodOncallRole --role-session-name kevin-onswing
```

kevin: running that -> AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole on resource arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/RedwoodOncallRole
maria: that means your IAM user isn't in the permitted principals list. sam, do we have a quick patch?
sam: we can add a temporary principal mapping but need to document the change. i'll prepare a short PR to infra-iam and request a 1hr TTL. linking PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/3821
sam: (added) PR created, requesting emergency review. tagging @jess for merge.
jess: on it, quick review incoming. if sec signs off i'll merge + run deploy.
kevin: appreciate it. timeline?
sam: if jess merges within 10m and infra pipeline passes, you should be able to assume role in ~12m.
maria: good. two operational points for the handoff message: 1) Primary: maria until 02:00 UTC, 2) Secondary: kevin from 23:45-01:30 UTC (subject to perms), fallback: tara then sam. include runbook links.
maria: runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pagerduty-escalation
tara: quick reminder for whoever takes the 00:30-01:15 gap — if you can't get a human secondary, set PD to escalate to the oncall phone line and open a bridge. use this bridge template:

```
# bridge start
/bridge open redwood-inference-production
/bridge topic: "Night swing coverage — temporary single-primary"
```

kevin: sec approved the temporary Grafana uplift (45m), PD group add pending, sam's PR merged — i can now assume the role. testing...
kevin: success: assumed role and can access CloudWatch logs. Grafana silences also working. :tada:
maria: perfect. i'll send the formal handoff: "maria primary until 02:00 UTC; kevin secondary 23:45-01:30 UTC (permissions verified); tara fallback 01:30-02:00 UTC if needed."
sam: leaving a note in the ops channel and tagging incident-bot to annotate the rotation.
deploy-bot: Deploy Bot: infra-iam PR #3821 merged to main and applied to prod (short TTL injected).
maria: thanks everyone. two action items for post-shift: 1) remove the temporary principal mapping, 2) file a short postmortem if any permission gaps caused extra paging.
kevin: will do. logging steps in the shift-note doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/shifts/220123-swing-notes
maria: ok i'll close this thread once i post the handoff announcement. :lock:"
